title: Reply
description: A reply to a comment on a file. Some resource methods (such as `replies.update`) require a `replyId`. Use the `replies.list` method to retrieve the ID for a reply.

assigneeEmailAddress.description: Output only. The email address of the user assigned to this comment. If no user is assigned, the field is unset.

action.description: The action the reply performed to the parent comment. The supported values are: * `resolve` * `reopen`

htmlContent.description: Output only. The content of the reply with HTML formatting.

kind.description: Output only. Identifies what kind of resource this is. Value: the fixed string `"drive#reply"`.

id.description: Output only. The ID of the reply.

createdTime.description: The time at which the reply was created (RFC 3339 date-time).

deleted.description: Output only. Whether the reply has been deleted. A deleted reply has no content.

content.description: The plain text content of the reply. This field is used for setting the content, while `htmlContent` should be displayed. This field is required by the `create` method if no `action` value is specified.

mentionedEmailAddresses.description: Output only. A list of email addresses for users mentioned in this comment. If no users are mentioned, the list is empty.

modifiedTime.description: The last time the reply was modified (RFC 3339 date-time).
